title: Computational discovery of novel inhibitory candidates targeting versatile transcriptional repressor MBD2.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选靶向MBD2甲基化DNA结合域的小分子抑制剂，聚焦蛋白-DNA互作界面，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象为甲基化阅读器而非典型转录因子。
abstract: Genome methylation is a key epigenetic mechanism in various biological events such as development, cellular differentiation, cancer progression, aging, and iPSC reprogramming. Crosstalk between DNA methylation and gene expression is mediated by MBD2, known as the reader of DNA methylation and suggested as a drug target. Despite its magnitude of significance, a scarcely limited number of small molecules to be used as inhibitors have been detected so far. Therefore, we screened a comprehensive compound library to elicit MBD2 inhibitor candidates. Promising molecules were subjected to computational docking analysis by targeting the methylated DNA-binding domain of human MBD2. We could detect reasonable binding energies and docking residues, presumably located in druggable pockets. Docking results were also validated via MD simulation and per-residue energy decomposition calculation. Drug-likeness of these small molecules was assessed through ADMET prediction to foresee off-target side effects for future studies. All computational approaches notably highlighted two compounds named CID3100583 and 8,8-ethylenebistheophylline. These compounds have become prominent as novel candidates, possibly disrupting MBD2(MBD)-DNA interaction. Consequently, these compounds have been considered prospective inhibitors with the usage potential in a wide range of applications from cancer treatment to somatic cell reprogramming protocols.
abstract_zh: 基因组甲基化是多种生物事件中的关键表观遗传机制，如发育、细胞分化、癌症进展、衰老及iPSC重编程。DNA甲基化与基因表达之间的交互作用由MBD2介导，该蛋白被称为DNA甲基化的读取器，并被认为是药物靶点。尽管其重要性巨大，但迄今检测到的可用作抑制剂的小分子数量极为有限。因此，我们筛选了一个全面的化合物库以寻找MBD2抑制剂候选物。有前景的分子通过靶向人MBD2的甲基化DNA结合域进行了计算对接分析。我们检测到了合理的结合能和对接残基，这些残基可能位于可成药口袋中。对接结果还通过分子动力学（MD）模拟和逐残基能量分解计算进行了验证。这些小分子的药物相似性通过ADMET预测评估，以预见未来研究中的脱靶副作用。所有计算方法均显著突出了两种化合物，即CID3100583和8,8-亚乙基双茶碱。这些化合物作为新型候选物脱颖而出，可能破坏MBD2(MBD)-DNA相互作用。因此，这些化合物被视为具有广泛应用潜力的前景抑制剂，从癌症治疗到体细胞重编程方案均适用。
